Run >NIL: Execute S:CEF-StartupMonitor

Run >RAM:CEF-host.log Execute S:CEFHost-Run

Echo ARM58-probe-wait-failed >DEBUG:
Quit 20
EndIf

Echo ARM58-host-exit-timeout >DEBUG:
Quit 20
EndIf
Type RAM:CEF-host.log >DEBUG:
Type RAM:CEF-appA.log >DEBUG:
Echo ARM58-test-finished >DEBUG:
Wait 3600
